title: Reserves Held on a Host Payout Account and What Further Cost Is Accepted At
content:
What the marketplace holds in reserve against a host, measured against everything the appraisals on the Keyturn Host Protection Plan enrolment have valued, settles how much of the further cost is accepted.

- Where the reserves standing on the host's payout account are below everything the appraisals on the enrolment have valued and the account is active, the further cost is accepted at the marketplace's unreserved share of 95 percent, the marketplace's own provision being short of what it has already accepted.
- Where the account is not active, it is accepted at the marketplace's stopped-account share of 88 percent.
- Where those reserves are at least everything those appraisals have valued and the account is active, nothing is taken off on that account.

### Condition, judgement, result

| Reserves against the appraised total | State of the account | Accepted at |
|---|---|---|
| below it | active | 95 percent |
| any | not active | 88 percent |
| at least it | active | the whole of it |

An account that is not active carries its own share whatever the reserves standing on it.

### What the records show

The reserves and the state of the account are read from the host's Keyturn Host Payout Account, and the appraised total is everything the appraisals standing on this enrolment have valued.
